policies.inbound:
<set-variable name="promptText" value="@{
        var reqBody = context.Request.Body.As(preserveContent: true);
        var messages = (JArray)reqBody["messages"];
        var lastUserMessage = "";
        foreach (var m in messages) {
            if ((string)m["role"] == "user") {
                lastUserMessage = (string)m["content"];
            }
        }
        return lastUserMessage;
    }" />
    
      https://prompt-governance-functions.azurewebsites.net/api/classification?code={{classification-function-key}}
      POST
      
        application/json
      
      @{
          return new JObject(new JProperty("prompt", (string)context.Variables["promptText"])).ToString();
      }
    
    <set-variable name="classificationResult" value="@(((IResponse)context.Variables["classificationResponse"]).Body.As(preserveContent: true))" />
    
      
        
          
          @(((JObject)context.Variables["classificationResult"]).ToString())
        
      
    
    
      @("Bearer {{openai-api-key}}")
